_marker: KNOWN FAILURES — a shrink-only ratchet read by recipe/fidelity-check.ts. Every row is a measured FAIL with its cause; the gate is red on any failing subject NOT listed here and on any listed subject that passes (stale). Nothing here changes a score. Classes: real-defect = the mint differs from the package render; content-mismatch = the mint's sample content differs from the capture's, so the pair is not like-for-like (fix: derive content from the capture, remint); font-substrate = the difference is glyph rasterisation/fallback metrics, not geometry.

alert/astryx.cause: 7.57% width-normalised (was 64.6%). After alert v3 the glyph, the Semibold title, the fill and the radius all match and heights agree at 44; the residual is the bold title's glyph rasterisation — SF Pro Semibold drawn by Figma vs -apple-system Semibold drawn by Chromium — across a 281px-wide title line, which the edge windows cannot avoid. Geometry the recipe decided is exhausted here.

chip/astryx.cause: 5.07% — 0.07 over the bar. Same label 'Tag', ink 36x24 vs 37x24; the 1px is glyph advance width under Figma's font fallback vs Chromium's.

link/mui.cause: 49.08%. Both sides render 'Link' in a serif fallback (MUI Link variant=inherit inherits the unstyled stage); 26x13 vs 31x14 is fallback-font metrics on both renderers, not geometry the recipe decided.

tabs/mui.cause: 18.07% (tabs v4). Labels, count, colours and the 48px tab now match the two-item capture. The indicator is drawn label-wide directly under the text (y=30, 69x2); MUI positions it absolute at the tab's bottom edge (y=46) across the full tab width including padding (101x2). library-tabs.ts receipted the 100% width as Polar and the recipe stacked it under the label — invented placement, the same class as the alert disc. Fix: absolute bottom-stretch indicator.

textarea/astryx.cause: 6.16% width-normalised (heights 87 vs 89). The native resize grip is a named refusal (library-textareas.ts refusal-resize) and is absent from the mint; placeholder text differs slightly in weight.

textarea/mui.cause: 9.52% width-normalised (heights 58 vs 56). Resize grip absent (named refusal); the floating label offset differs by ~2px.

textarea/antd.cause: 7.42% width-normalised (heights 75 vs 54). The mint stacks a 'Notes' label above the box; antd TextArea renders NO label — the recipe grammar requires one (labelPlacement stacked). Structure the package does not render, plus the absent resize grip.
